title: Software Engineering Intern
description: Work alongside senior engineers to build scalable web applications. Contribute to real-world projects, participate in sprint planning, and gain hands-on experience with modern web technologies.

title: Data Science Intern
description: Assist the data science team in building predictive models and extracting insights from large datasets. Ideal for students studying Computer Science, Mathematics, or Statistics.

title: UX Research Intern
description: Conduct user interviews, usability tests, and help create accessibility-first design systems. A great opportunity for students passionate about inclusive design.

title: Cybersecurity Intern
description: Support the security operations team with threat monitoring, vulnerability assessments, and incident response activities.

title: Product Management Intern
description: Work with cross-functional teams to define product requirements, create roadmaps, and analyse user feedback to drive product improvements.

title: Frontend Developer Intern
description: Build pixel-perfect, accessible user interfaces for client projects. Collaborate with designers and backend developers to deliver exceptional web experiences.

title: Cloud Infrastructure Intern
description: Assist in managing and optimising cloud infrastructure, automating deployment pipelines, and monitoring system performance.

title: Machine Learning Research Intern
description: Collaborate with researchers to develop and evaluate machine learning models. Ideal for students interested in AI and academic research environments.

title: Marketing Technology Intern
description: Support the marketing team with data-driven campaigns, SEO optimisation, and content strategy to drive user acquisition.

title: Backend Engineering Intern
description: Build and maintain robust backend services and APIs. Work on database design, server optimisation, and third-party integrations.

title: Accessibility Engineering Intern
description: Champion accessible web development by auditing existing products, writing accessible code, and training development teams on WCAG 2.1 standards.

title: Business Intelligence Intern
description: Transform raw data into actionable business insights. Build dashboards, write SQL queries, and present findings to stakeholders.

title: Software QA Intern
description: Support the QA team with manual and automated testing, write bug reports, and help improve release confidence across web products.

title: Mobile App Development Intern
description: Work on mobile app features, test builds on Android and iOS, and collaborate with product and design teams on user-facing improvements.

title: AI Product Intern
description: Help scope AI-supported product features, assess user needs, and document how machine learning workflows should support real-world users.

title: Junior Data Engineering Intern
description: Assist with data pipeline maintenance, write transformation scripts, and support the delivery of cleaner datasets for analytics teams.

title: Content Design Intern
description: Design clearer digital content and microcopy for public-facing services with a strong focus on accessibility and usability.

title: Sustainability Data Intern
description: Analyse sustainability reporting data, prepare dashboards, and support consultants delivering insight to clients across the UK.

title: Game Development Intern
description: Support gameplay and tooling teams on a live student-friendly project and gain experience with cross-disciplinary development workflows.

title: DevOps Automation Intern
description: Help automate deployment workflows, improve observability, and support infrastructure documentation for engineering teams.

title: User Experience Design Intern
description: Create interface concepts, support usability testing, and iterate on product flows for student and public-sector clients.

title: Technical Support Intern
description: Work with support engineers to solve user issues, document recurring problems, and improve the quality of internal knowledge bases.

title: Policy and Data Intern
description: Support research and policy work using structured datasets, desk research, and clear written summaries for non-technical audiences.

title: Financial Technology Intern
description: Contribute to internal financial systems, support API integrations, and learn how secure transaction platforms are developed and maintained.

title: Digital Accessibility Intern
description: Audit digital products, write accessibility recommendations, and support teams improving inclusive design and development practices.

title: Software Consultancy Intern
description: Work on client-facing software features, participate in agile planning, and gain experience in consultancy-style delivery.

title: Research Software Intern
description: Support academic and applied research projects by building small tools, cleaning datasets, and documenting reproducible workflows.

title: E-commerce Product Intern
description: Assist the product team in prioritising user needs, analysing feature usage, and shaping roadmap decisions for e-commerce products.

title: Software Support and Testing Intern
description: Combine application support with structured testing, helping the team diagnose issues and improve software quality before release.

title: Junior Security Operations Intern
description: Support a security operations team with monitoring tasks, triage workflows, and hands-on exposure to operational security practices.

title: Business Systems Intern
description: Map workflows, support systems improvements, and help teams understand how operational processes can be simplified with better digital tools.

title: Analytics and Insight Intern
description: Support reporting and insight generation for campaign and audience data, turning metrics into practical recommendations.

title: Web Content and SEO Intern
description: Help improve search visibility and content quality across web properties while learning how digital marketing teams work with content performance data.

title: Junior Full Stack Intern
description: Support feature delivery across the stack, working with frontend and backend developers on practical business software.

title: Research Assistant Intern
description: Assist on digital education research by preparing survey summaries, coding feedback themes, and supporting structured analysis work.

title: Junior Platform Engineer Intern
description: Work with platform engineers on deployment tooling, cloud operations, and internal engineering systems that support product teams.
